title: Ping all IPv6 local network hosts
summary: Send IPv6 packets to the local network multicast address to discover or check all IPv6 hosts on your local segment.

steps.explain: Send IPv6 packets to the all-nodes multicast address on the specified interface.

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The network interface name (e.g., eth0, wlan0).

steps.expect: Replies from IPv6 hosts on the local network.
